files.patch:
Index: /tmp/opencode/alacritty-layout-test.toml
===================================================================
--- /tmp/opencode/alacritty-layout-test.toml
+++ /tmp/opencode/alacritty-layout-test.toml
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+[window]
+width = 60
+height = 10
+
+# Проверка 1: логический key (зависит от раскладки?)
+[[keyboard.bindings]]
+key = "A"
+mods = "Control"
+chars = "LOGIC"
+
+# Проверка 2: physical_key (layout-independent?)
+[[keyboard.bindings]]
+physical_key = "A"
+mods = "Control"
+chars = "PHYS"
